# KESHO-UPDATE-03 — Backup, weekly report, organized project — first sync with GitHub

**For Copilot.** Claude wrote this. Follow the steps in order. Do not edit app code.
Local folder: `C:\Users\reuben\Desktop\kesho` · GitHub: `https://github.com/benru254/Kesho` (branch `main`).

From this update on, **GitHub holds the code**. Claude already pushed everything for Update 03 there
(tested: 89 automated checks + a real Android compile with Expo SDK 54). Your job is to bring this PC in line
with GitHub — WITHOUT losing the two things that only exist on this PC:
- `app/app.json` → contains the EAS project id (added by `eas init` in Update 01)
- the files `create-expo-module` generated in `app/modules/kesho-sms/` (e.g. `android/build.gradle`) in Update 02

## What Update 03 adds
- Backup & restore to Google Drive (Settings → Backup), undo restore, "backup is old" banner, 19:30 reminder
- 📊 Report tab: weekly report, change vs last week, 28-day patterns, one focus, Sunday 19:00 notification
- ⚙️ Settings tab (Reminders + Backup), README + full docs, automated tests (`npm test`)
- 3 new packages: expo-file-system, expo-sharing, expo-document-picker

---

## STEP 0 — Prerequisites (report; STOP if one fails)
1. `app\eas.json` exists (Update 01 done) and `app\modules\kesho-sms\android\build.gradle` exists (Update 02 done).
   If not: do those first (`docs\tasks\KESHO-UPDATE-01.md`, `KESHO-UPDATE-02.md` on GitHub), then come back.
2. `node --version` must be **22 or newer**. If older: `winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS`, reopen the terminal.
3. Stop all Expo/Metro processes.
4. If `git status` shows uncommitted changes: `git add .` → `git commit -m "PC state before update 03"`.

## STEP 1 — Back up the PC-only file
```
cd C:\Users\reuben\Desktop\kesho
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\Users\reuben\Desktop\_kesho-archive\update03 | Out-Null
Copy-Item app\app.json C:\Users\reuben\Desktop\_kesho-archive\update03\app.json
```

## STEP 2 — Connect to GitHub and take its code
```
git remote -v
```
- No `origin`: `git remote add origin https://github.com/benru254/Kesho.git`
- `origin` points elsewhere: `git remote set-url origin https://github.com/benru254/Kesho.git`
```
git fetch origin
git checkout origin/main -- .
```
(A GitHub sign-in window may open — **Reuben signs in himself**, account `benru254`.)

## STEP 3 — Put the PC-only file back, archive the replaced file
```
Copy-Item C:\Users\reuben\Desktop\_kesho-archive\update03\app.json app\app.json -Force
Move-Item app\src\features\reminders\RemindersScreen.js C:\Users\reuben\Desktop\_kesho-archive\update03\ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```
Then open `app\app.json` and check it still has `extra.eas.projectId`. Report if not.

## STEP 4 — Make GitHub's history this folder's history
```
git reset --soft origin/main
git branch -M main
git status
```
Expected in `git status`: `app/app.json` modified (projectId), new files under `app/modules/kesho-sms/`
(generated by Expo), maybe `app/package-lock.json`. **Nothing under `app/src/`.**
If anything under `app/src/` shows as changed: STOP and report the list.

## STEP 5 — Install, test, compile
```
cd app
npm install
npm test
npx expo export --platform android
```
- `npm test` must end with `8 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped`.
- The export must finish without errors.
If anything fails: STOP, copy the full output for Claude. Never run `npm audit fix`.

## STEP 6 — Build the APK
```
eas build -p android --profile preview
```
Reuse the existing keystore. Give Reuben the link to open on his phone.

## STEP 7 — Reuben tests on the phone
1. Tabs: Today · Money · Report · Settings. Old data is still there.
2. Settings → Reminders → send a test reminder → it arrives.
3. Settings → Backup → "Back up to Google Drive" → choose Drive → Save → the file appears in Drive.
4. "Restore from a backup file" → pick that file → "Replace my data" → "Restored ✓", data unchanged; "Undo the last restore" appears.
5. Report tab: this week (last week on Mondays), ‹ › moves weeks, Focus card shows one sentence.
6. If no backup was ever made: a "💾 No backup yet" strip above the tabs; "Later" hides it until tomorrow.

## STEP 8 — Push this PC's own files (after Reuben confirms Step 7)
Privacy check first (the repository is PUBLIC):
```
cd C:\Users\reuben\Desktop\kesho
git add .
git status
git diff --cached --name-only | Select-String -Pattern "kesho-backup|\.db$|\.jks$|\.keystore$|credentials|\.env|\.apk$"
```
The last command must print NOTHING. Then:
```
git commit -m "PC: EAS project id, generated kesho-sms module files, lockfile"
git push -u origin main
```
If the push is rejected: `git pull --rebase origin main`, then `git push` again.

Node version · Step 4 `git status` list · test + compile results · build link · push result.
